description: Call sweep_ops on the ledger (D-117): pays the gas & ops line's unspent balance above OPS_RESERVE into the ratchet pool, raising T with no emission. Permissionless; the 0.03 GRAM attached stays on the ledger and is swept next time. Refused when nothing is sweepable, because the call would be a no-op.

confirm.description: Send it. Without this the tool only quotes what the transaction would cost.

name: primes_sweep_ops
